capture_method: Tesla public Megapack configurator, read directly from the order page
notes: Earliest selectable delivery quarter was Q1 2027. No 2026 quarters offered.
Delivery quarters offered: 2027 Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4.
Site location held constant at California for both observations.

derived.method: Two observations hold unit count constant (5) and energy near-constant (19.3 vs 19.6 MWh) while power halves (9.6 -> 4.9 MW). Solving price = a*energy_kWh + b*power_kW as a 2x2 linear system separates energy-capacity cost from power-conversion cost.

residual_check.comment: Fits both points to within rounding, as expected for 2 equations and 2 unknowns.

caveats: IMPORTANT: two equations with two unknowns fit exactly by construction. This is not yet evidence that pricing is linear in energy and power.
Before relying on the decomposition, gather additional points by varying megapack_quantity and site_state to test linearity and check for volume breaks or state-level freight/tax effects.
Configurator price is a customer-facing quote, not Tesla's internal cost. The decomposition separates PRICE into energy and power components; converting to cost requires a margin assumption.
